  • Title Example

    Coldwater Omega-3 uses highly concentrated fish oils, so the majority of the oil in the capsules is DHA and EPA - the forms of omega-3s that are most easily used by the human body.

  • Title Example

    Making Coldwater Omega-3 begins with the best source of fish oils which are purified and molecularly distilled using water, without solvents or excessive heat that could alter the oils. Independent auditors certify them to be free of any toxins or contaminants.

Ingredients

Ingredient Glossary

  • Source Organic compound
  • Why we choose it Helps stabilize product, improve enzyme performance, and allow for concentration with a proven safety record.

Ingredient Summary

ProvexCV
Proprietary Blend: Grape Seed Extract(Vitis vinifera [seed] extract), Resveratrol(Polygonum cuspidatum [root] extract), Green Tea Extract (Camellia sinensis [leaf] extract), Proprietary Blend: Protease (Aspergillus oryzae var), Bromelian (Ananas comosus [stem]), Quercetin Powder (Sophora japonica [bud] extract). Other ingredients: Gelatin, microcrystalline cellulosa, magnesium stearate, silicon dioxide.

Where do omega-3s come from?

  • Marine Omega-3 begins in the ocean with one of the most basic organisms–algae. Using energy from the sun, these algae create the short fatty acid alpha-linolenic acid (ALA) and the long fatty acid docosahexaenoic acid (DHA).

    Fatty acids: ALA, DHA

  • Algae are consumed by plankton, and plankton are then consumed by fish. Both the plankton and fatty fish such as anchovy, sardine, and mackerel convert the short chain ALA into long chain eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and more DHA.

    Converts ALA to EPA fatty acids and more DHA

  • And fish are then consumed by us. DHA & EPA have benefits to human health.

    Fatty acids: DHA, EPA

  • Green Coffee Bean Extract

    Backed by multiple clinical studies, this proprietary extract helps slow blood sugar absorption and supports the release of fat for enhanced metabolic support.*

    Unlike most green coffee bean extracts, this proprietary version is standardized to contain at least 45% chlorogenic acid. This natural compound is what powers the glucose regulation and fat burning effects from green coffee bean extract.*

  • Green Tea Phytosome Complex

    Clinically shown to deliver up to three times the beneficial properties of traditional green tea extract, this highly bioavailable, caffeine-free complex provides a thermogenic effect that helps promote fat utilization and greater calorie burn.*

    This potent, standardized green tea extract is combined with natural phospholipids to deliver up to 3X greater bioavailability of EGCG, which has been clinically shown to increase calorie burn and fat utilization, leading to improved body composition when part of a low-calorie diet.*

  • Capsaicin Pepper Extract

    Using a controlled-release beadlet technology to help avoid burning or discomfort, this hot pepper extract promotes fat breakdown and thermogenic energy production.

    The capsaicinoids in this highly concentrated hot pepper extract have been clinically shown to provide powerful, controlled-release thermogenic and lipolytic (fat mobilization) benefits without the worry of gastric or oral discomfort.
